stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

remnant_orchestra_flautist.name: Remnant Orchestra Flautist
remnant_orchestra_flautist.flavourText: Flautist who wants to join their king's orchestra. This nobody has never seen the spectacle, and is all the more fanatical for it.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack has increased ATK

remnant_orchestra_wind_player.name: Remnant Orchestra Wind Player
remnant_orchestra_wind_player.flavourText: Wind player who wants to become the concertmaster of their king's orchestra. He worked hard to climb the ladder, but the orchestra is long gone, for which he is very resentful.
abilities: ATK continuously increases when unblocked. ATK is reset after the next attack.
When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and attacks Stun the target

remnant_orchestra_cellist.name: Remnant Orchestra Cellist
remnant_orchestra_cellist.flavourText: Cellist who wants to be their king's trusted henchman. He lives to earn their king's favor, for which he is willing to play obsequious tunes.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by your units

When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and gains a Shield that protects against a certain number of attacks; each time damage is prevented, reflects as Physical damage based on own ATK

sarkaz_wither_maw.name: Sarkaz Wither Maw
sarkaz_wither_maw.flavourText: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it. Only death can make it surrender what it devoured.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced

finale_cadence.name: Finale Cadence
finale_cadence.flavourText: The only way to the end.
abilities: Drops a random Collectible when it enters the Protection Objective; Remaining HP carries over to the next operation

lost_hovercraft.name: Lost Hovercraft
lost_hovercraft.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. Despite its ability to hover for extended periods, its built-in package protection mechanism compels it to land immediately upon encountering interference.
abilities: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

lost_contraption.name: Lost Contraption
lost_contraption.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. It has continuously operated for so long that its movements have become slow and haphazard.
abilities: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

portal.name: 'Portal'
portal.flavourText: A portal that follows the living and can occasionally be encountered in the Furnace. Do not fear if it compels you to enter, for it has already prepared an exit.
abilities: Temporarily removes an Operator from the squad when it disappears.

window.name: 'Window'
window.flavourText: A solitary window, manifested from all that is bright and beautiful within the dark void. Find the strength to open it, and you will behold prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.
abilities: Upon defeating the 'Window', the player will enter Prosperity

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

emergency.condition: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP, Tuning Nodes require more SP to activate
